contentPattern: One row, two cells. Cell 1: brand logo image. Cell 2: heading/label ("Subscribe to our newsletter") and the Subscribe link.
usage: Newsletter sign-up band shown above the footer on every page; logo left, label and Subscribe button right on desktop, stacked and centred on mobile.
reuseGuidance: Appears site-wide; consider placing it in the footer fragment rather than authoring it per page.
